images.name: GitHub sign-in
images.reason: Already a compact 364px dialog with a strong existing outline around Continue with GitHub. Another callout would duplicate it.

images.name: Rulebook message
images.reason: Already a tight four-line CLI crop with one explicit loading message; the adjacent caption names that exact line.

images.name: Plan review
images.reason: The full VS Code window makes the path and plan requirements too small. Separate source crops focus on the file, target and identity requirement.
images.alt: 1: Open plan.md and its compliance report. 2: Find the .NET 10 target. 3: Check managed-identity database access.
images.caption: *1. Open the plan and compliance report. 2. Find the .NET 10 target. 3. Check the managed-identity requirement.*

panels.label: Open the plan and compliance report

images.name: Starting task states
images.reason: Use three clearly separated close-ups so the task metadata location and both actual id/status pairs remain legible at 450px.
images.alt: 1: Locate .metadata/tasks.json. 2: Task 001 runtime upgrade has status success. 3: Task 002 Web Forms conversion has status success.
images.caption: *1. Locate `tasks.json`. 2-3. Confirm `success` for the runtime upgrade and Web Forms conversion.*

images.name: Build and tests
images.reason: Remove empty terminal area and enlarge the actual build result and test-summary counters rather than inventing output.
images.alt: 1: Build succeeded. 2: The test summary shows zero failed tests and 13 succeeded.
images.caption: *1. Look for `Build succeeded`. 2. Check `failed: 0` in the test summary.*

panels.label: Check the test summary for failures

images.name: Local route responses
images.reason: The result summaries already contain the relevant values; enlarge those original pixels instead of shrinking the whole terminal.
images.alt: 1: The health response is OK with HTTP 200. 2: WhoAmI returns authenticated false with HTTP 200.
images.caption: *1. `/health`: HTTP 200 and `OK`. 2. `/WhoAmI.ashx`: HTTP 200 and `{"authenticated":false}`.*

images.name: Import destination
images.reason: Separate account/name, Private visibility and Begin import into the three actions; retain the account redaction.
images.alt: 1: Choose the lab owner and repository name. 2: Keep Private selected. 3: Begin import.

panels.label: Choose your lab owner and repository name

images.name: Import in progress
images.reason: A single progress state is already isolated and outlined. Extra marks would add noise or risk implying the import completed.

images.name: Assigned agent
images.reason: Focus on the existing agent-name link rather than the unrelated Create agent control. No redacted content is reconstructed.
images.alt: Open the assigned Caldova agent from the Name column.

images.name: Context wizard
images.reason: The decorative header dominates the original; emphasize Quickstart, the Code add control and the connected Logs indicator.
images.alt: 1: Keep Quickstart selected. 2: Locate the Code add control. 3: Review the Logs card.

images.name: Resource group scope
images.reason: The next action concerns the resource-group boundary, not the empty higher-level scope cards.
images.alt: Review Resource group scope and leave the assigned ResourceGroup1 entry unchanged.

panels.label: Review Resource group scope; leave it unchanged

images.name: Connected log providers
images.reason: Enlarge the Service and Status columns together so both providers stay associated with their actual Connected values.
images.alt: Confirm Application Insights and Log Analytics both show Connected.

panels.label: Confirm both log providers are Connected

images.name: Repository connection
images.reason: Remove unrelated empty wizard space and focus on selecting GitHub and entering the imported copy URL. The empty field remains empty.
images.alt: 1: Select GitHub. 2: Enter the imported lab repository URL.

images.name: GitHub OAuth
images.reason: The compact crop already isolates selected OAuth and the blue Sign in to GitHub button; extra annotations would repeat two obvious controls.

images.name: Saved repository
images.reason: Enlarge the repository count and display-name entry without exposing or replacing the masked URL or claiming a new status.
images.alt: Confirm the Code card lists one repository and the imported repository name.

panels.label: Confirm your imported repository is listed

images.name: Getting started thread
images.reason: Remove the empty sidebar and enlarge saved context plus the place to ask the next question. The original masked identity is not recreated.
images.alt: 1: Review the saved context files. 2: Ask a follow-up in the chat box.

panels.label: Ask a follow-up in the chat box

images.name: App Service hostname
images.reason: Isolate the Default Hostname label and its actual value; do not turn the example hostname into a new lab URL.
images.alt: 1: Find Default Hostname. 2: Read the hostname from your app's response.

panels.label: Use the hostname from your own response

images.name: Search failure
images.reason: Remove wide blank space and connect the jacket search to the actual HTTP500 failure. Keep the red failure state unchanged.
images.alt: 1: Search for jacket. 2: Observe 500 - Search failed and HTTP 500.

images.name: Scheduled task run
images.reason: The wide narrow strip makes all three important controls unreadable at guide width. Separate schedule, run control and execution link.
images.alt: 1: Review the schedule. 2: Run task now only if no run is pending. 3: Open the execution thread.

panels.label: Run once only if no run is pending

images.name: Cost review output
images.reason: Stack chart, resource table and assumptions instead of shrinking two columns. Preserve the example estimate and pricing caveats.
images.alt: 1: Read the cost chart. 2: Compare resource estimates. 3: Read the pricing assumptions.

images.name: Live report map
images.reason: Keep the whole dependency map with inferred edges and actual health colors, then enlarge its legend and authoring control.
images.alt: 1: Select a service on the map. 2: Read the health legend. 3: Use Open authoring thread to refine the report.

panels.label: Select a service on the map

images.name: Live report details
images.reason: Enlarge counts, response times and endpoint rows while preserving failing values. Endpoint columns are separated by an explicit crop gutter.
images.alt: 1: Read request and failure counts. 2: Compare response times. 3: Match endpoints to request counts.

images.name: AAU limit
images.reason: Split the long limit strip so its amount and Change AAU allocation control can both be read at guide width.
images.alt: 1: Review the monthly allowance. 2: Locate Change AAU allocation.

images.name: AAU allocation controls
images.reason: Emphasize the existing allowance and Cancel rather than the disabled Save control; do not change the displayed amount.
images.alt: 1: Inspect the monthly active-flow allowance without editing it. 2: Select Cancel.

panels.label: Inspect the allowance without changing it

images.name: Consumption by thread
images.reason: Zoom the three columns requested by the exercise and retain both Active and Completed rows. Keep attribution and identify the adaptation.
images.alt: Compare Thread type, AAUs and Status in the same rows; Active and Completed states remain unchanged.
